title: Data space self-description and identifier

statement.en: The governance authority shall publish at a well-known address a machine-readable self-description of the data space that states its identifier, the location and version of its rulebook, its catalogue and connector endpoints, the policy and semantic profiles it uses, the trust framework it applies and the onboarding checks it accepts, and its joining conditions. Claims and metadata that rely on the data space's policies shall carry its identifier.

control: The self-description resolves at the well-known address and validates against the Level 1 format; the identifier appears in claims and metadata
trustFramework: The self-description names the trust framework; its own authenticity is signed under it

expressions.note: JSON-LD self-description. The DSIF Connection Profile and the Gaia-X self-description are the candidate formats.

source: DS4Skills rulebook v0.4 GOV-09, TRUST-09, TRUST-10
